body.x: SOULX Co., Ltd. (CEO Young-taeck Hwang) participated in the 'Startup Zone' at the Eureka Park K-STARTUP integrated hall of 'CES 2023' in Las Vegas, USA from January 5 (Thursday) to 8 (Sunday, local time) for a total of 4 days.

SOULX, which provides the ‘VRoom™‘ solution, is a creative group that holds culture, art, and experiential values. They convey differentiated concepts and worlds through various storytelling methods (digital content creation, product creation, games, branding, exhibitions, etc.). In particular, they conduct business in a way that adds communication to people’s creation by developing software and platforms that use XR.

Over 3 years, between 2019~2021, they were able to have accomplishments such as filming and creating a total of 54 XR video content, record annual sales growth rates of 300% (accumulated statistics, in-house), and be selected for a total of 8 R&D tasks during the same period with a 100% success rate (cumulative statistics of public institution and corporate tasks, in-house)

SOULX’s VRoom is a ‘Real-Time XR-Based Content Creation Software Solution’ that utilizes game engine-based ‘real-time video synthesis technology’ and ‘3D asset source synthesis functions’ to enable non-professionals, amateurs, and regular people to easily create high-quality video content.

SOULX explained that it uses photorealistic quality real-time 3D virtual space video synthesis functions and asset platforms to reduce the average production time of high-quality video content by 45% and production costs by an average of 70% in comparison to existing methods. As a solution optimized for the changing media trend centered on ‘short-form media’, which is rapidly created and consumed’, it enables easy and effective visual storytelling.

An official of SOULX explained that, “In the midst of changes in the media market, where anyone can become video creators and the influence of video content is growing across industries, the creation environment for short-form content, which is increasingly rapidly being produced and consumed, is lagging behind the trend. VRoom is a powerful tool enabling limitless storytelling using virtual spaces through quick and easy XR-based content creation at a reasonable price.”

They went on to explain the background of their participation in the trade show, saying, “As VRoom is a tool for creators, we aim to showcase the solution’s excellence and potential of its usability externally through collaborations with global creators, virtual influencers, and others. As such, we plan to reveal the beta version of VRoom (VRoom 0.7.1.) at CES 2023 for the first time.”

They also shared their future plans. The official said, “The 3D asset platform, which connects with VRoom’s asset library, is preparing to build a P2P open market platform that provides copyright free assets and NFT-based assets so that any artist can create and sell assets and video creators can purchase and use them,” and said, “We plan on making a sustainable positive feedback cycle so that creators can create profit.”

‘CES’ is the world’s biggest IT trade show and is a place where one can see the direction and trends of the appliance industry of the entire world. Hosted by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), it is held annually in Las Vegas, USA in January. Having reported on CES for 17 consecutive years, AVING News started reporting news of CES to the entire world since 2006, and conducted ‘BEST OF CES’, which chose the most innovative product and technology, and ‘BEST OF MADE IN KOREA, which chose the best innovative company in Korea. In addition, it vividly relayed on-site issues in CES through ‘AVING LIVE’.

The K-STARTUP Joint Pavilion featured joint participation of institutions like the Korea Institute of Startup & Entrepreneurship Development, Seoul Business Agency, and Seoul Digital Foundation, as well as 51 Korean innovative companies, to enter the US market and discover global partners. In addition, university student supporters of CES 2023 chosen by each university (Kyunghee, Kookmin, Sogang, Chung-Ang) matched to participating companies based on their respective majors and fields of business.
* Special Report Team : Joseph Choe, Kidai Kim, Dongkwan Kim, Mokkyung Lee, Sangun Choi, Joon Suh Lee, Yeawon Choi, Jinnsun Park, Seung Hyun Nam, Min Seok Cha
